name: IRAS 06070-6147 (Hubble)
blurb: IRAS 06070-6147, an edge-on spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: iras060706147-hubble
story: A spiral galaxy turned edge-on to us, with a lane of dust along its disk. Hubble surveyed galaxies like this one to map the fine structure of the dust, which traces the cold gas between the stars.

claims.text: IRAS06070-6147 is a target of program 9765, a survey of nearby edge-on spiral galaxies
IRAS06070-6147 is a disk galaxy with a dust lane and spiral structure
The survey measures small-scale dust structure, which traces the cold interstellar medium
